message.content: Static typing catches type mismatches and logical errors at compile time rather than letting them surface as runtime crashes, which drastically reduces debugging overhead in massive codebases. Additionally, it serves as built-in documentation that powers IDE autocompletion and safe refactoring tools, allowing developers to navigate and modify complex systems without needing to memorize every interface.
